thought.text: The container wasn't recreated (config is loaded at process start). Let me restart it to pick up the new config.

reasoning_content: The volume mount for asr-service.default.yml is a bind mount, so new files should be visible without a restart, but compose determined that the container was not changed ("Running" was displayed instead of "Recreated"). Since the config is loaded at service startup, a restart of the service process is required. Let's restart the container.

action.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && timeout 120 docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml restart asr-service 2>&1 | tail -3; sleep 25; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}'; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --tail 20 asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -vE "DEBUG|httpcore" | tail -15
